product_metadata.title: Village Candle Lemon Pound Cake Large Glass Apothecary Jar Scented Candle, 21.25 oz, Yellow
features: Fragrance notes of Vanilla Cupcake, Lemon, Hazelnut
Rich, vibrant yellow colored food-grade paraffin wax, fragranced by the finest scented oils.
Village Candle pioneered Dual Wick Technology providing a consistent fragrance release, longer burn time, and clean, even wax burn with less soot.
Large Apothecary candle provides up to 170 hours of fragrance. Dimensions are 3.8''L 3.8''W 6.75''H.

Our candles are proudly made in America, by our highly skilled candlemakers in Wells, Maine. Before reaching your home, each candle is quality checked and the cotton wicks are hand-trimmed by our talented team, ready for you to enjoy!

Now a global scent-sation, we’ve joined the Stonewall Kitchen Family of Brands where we’ll continue to create superior low-smoke candles with rich, memorable fragrances to brighten homes and hearts around the world.
Light your candle, spark an experience and know that every time you can expect the same high-quality candles that you’ve come to know and love all these years.
description: This crave-worthy lemon pound cake candle is one of Village Candle most-loved fragrance recipes. Imagine sugary lemon frosting drizzled over sweet lemon pound cake, with a pinch of hazelnut. Dessert never smelled so good. Village Candle's more than 75 fine fragrances provide the best in home decor with their ability to enhance life's moments and add ambiance to any living space. Treat yourself to Village Candle, because you deserve the best.
